name: Central Mine Planning & Design Institute Limited
publicShareholdingNotes: As per Rule 19(2)(b) of the Securities Contracts (Regulation) Rules, 1957, where the post-issue paid-up capital at the offer price exceeds Rs.4,000 crore, a minimum public offer of 10% is permitted. The Company's post-issue paid-up capital at the offer price is about Rs.12,280.13 crore; accordingly, the Offer complies with this requirement. Under Rule 19A of the SCRR read with Regulation 38 of the SEBI LODR Regulations, public shareholding will be increased to 25%.
